grass-base.assessment: All four examined as 3x3 repeats at native size and nearest-neighbor 3x, with enlarged wrap intersections. No visible seam, 1-/2-cell grid, distracting speckle, or dominant six-cell landmark at map scale. Summer stays dark and calm; autumn is muted olive/ochre-brown; winter has blue snow drifts and exposed-tip texture, not blank white. The changed spring base now textures and breaks up the formerly flat pale island around x=120-165, y=20-85; it no longer dominates the repeat. Grass remains finer and less tufted than plains. The three unchanged prior passes remain passed.

plains-base.assessment: All four examined as 3x3 repeats at native size and nearest-neighbor 3x, including enlarged wrap intersections. Continuous edges and corners, no visible 1-/2-cell grid, no isolated high-contrast six-cell repeat marker, and no blank or noisy areas that fail the shipping bar. Summer is lighter/yellower and more visibly tufted than grass. Spring has stronger distributed blade clusters than spring grass. Autumn reads as straw through short angled grass marks, not wood grain or sand. Winter retains blue snow texture and stronger exposed-tip/streak definition than winter grass. All four match their prior-review hashes and remain passed.
